event.title: VibeNova
event.description: VibeNovais an AI-assisted coding competition where participants use a designated chatbot and a strictly limited number of prompts to build a target implementation. The challenge tests strategic prompting, requirement understanding, debugging, and practical AI-assisted development. Participants must submit a GitHub repository and present their solution to judges. The winner is determined by functional accuracy, requirement matching, visual similarity, behaviour, presentation, and repository integrity.

event.title: NEBULA NEXUS
event.description: Nebula Nexus is a celestial-themed maze-solving challenge by the Algorithm & Programming Society (APS), NIT Rourkela, proposed for Innovision. Participants navigate through a maze while solving aptitude and logical reasoning questions at different checkpoints. They can choose from Easy, Medium, or Hard levels, each offering varying complexity and scoring. The event combines strategy, accuracy, logical thinking, and time management in an engaging competitive format.

event.title: Stellar Night
event.description: Stellar Night, the flagship event of AstroNITR during INNOVISION, is an overnight stargazing session that brings participants closer to the wonders of the night sky. Through telescope observations, participants can explore planets, stars, constellations, and other celestial objects. The event offers a unique opportunity to experience astronomy firsthand, fostering curiosity and appreciation for the cosmos under the serene night sky.

event.title: Cosmic Treasury
event.description: The Cosmic Treasury is a space-themed finance strategy game where teams manage a fictional colony with 10,000 Cosmic Credits. Over six rounds, participants trade assets, react to market decrees, use secret intelligence, negotiate, participate in an auction, make investments, and take calculated risks. The winner is the team with the highest final Cosmic Wealth, testing financial judgement, strategy, timing, information use, and risk management.

event.title: AetherHack
event.description: AetherHack is a national ideathon by INSPIRE, the Science and Research Club of NIT Rourkela. Open to college students across India, it invites original ideas in Sustainability, Robotics, Healthcare and an Open Track. Round 1 is online on Unstop with a written abstract. Ten finalists then pitch offline at Innovision before a professor panel. Winners share a ₹5,000 prize pool, enjoy three days of Innovision, and receive professor mentorship.

event.title: Earth 404
event.description: EARTH 404 is a two-day environmental and sustainability competition, with School Students participating on Day 1 and College Students on Day 2. The event challenges participants to understand, analyse, and respond to real-world ecological problems through engaging challenges that test environmental awareness, critical thinking, quick decision-making, analytical skills, and solution-building. Integrating technology, sustainability, and the celestial theme of INNOVISION, EARTH 404 takes participants from identifying environmental challenges to developing practical, innovative solutions.

event.title: WEBCLONE MANIA
event.description: WebCloneMania is a timed web development competition in which participants recreate a website shown by the organisers at the beginning of the event. The goal is to reproduce its visual design, layout, responsiveness, and key interactions as closely as possible within the given time.

event.title: Dead Man's Switch
event.description:
Each team consists of 2 or 3 participants. At the beginning of the event, the team will be randomly given a physical challenge. The selected participant will be designated as the “Dead Man” and must continuously perform the assigned physical activity while the remaining team members attempt to complete two consecutive challenges.
 The two stages are:
 1. Puzzle Challenge
 2. Buzz Wire Challenge
 After successfully completing both stages, the team will receive two clues. Using these clues, the Dead Man must identify and answer the final question within a maximum of three attempts.
 The team that completes the entire challenge in the minimum time will be declared the winner.
 
 Each team must complete the entire challenge within 150 seconds ( 2 minutes and 30 seconds).

The event focuses on innovation, problem-solving, and entrepreneurial thinking, providing participants with a platform to transform bold ideas into practical solutions and meaningful impact.

event.title: NOVAGRID
event.description: Mission NovaGrid is an interactive space-themed strategy game where players must find a new habitable planet after their home planet is destroyed. With limited fuel and credits, every route and decision matters. Players solve challenges, manage resources, and test different planets while adapting to unexpected outcomes. Designed for individuals or teams, the game combines strategy, problem-solving, and suspense in an engaging 15–20 minute experience.

event.title: Car Show / Automotive Exhibition
event.description: The Car Show is an interactive automotive exhibition and engineering showcase organized by Team Black Mamba Racing Electric during INNOVISION. The event features a display of student-designed competition vehicles, allowing attendees to closely examine key subsystems such as the chassis, suspension, powertrain, and electrical architectures while engaging with team members. Additionally, the vehicles of SAE NIT Rourkela will be running in the campus, providing live demonstrations of their performance and engineering capabilities.

event.title: LITTLE SCIENCE YARD
event.description: Little Science Yard (LSY) is AASRA’s annual flagship science exhibition designed to ignite curiosity and creative thinking among underprivileged students across various sectors. The event brings young minds together to showcase innovative working models and science projects at NIT Rourkela. Through interactive demonstrations, hands-on learning, and mentorship, LSY offers these students a unique platform to explore scientific concepts, build confidence, and present their ideas to an audience.

event.title: CYCLOTHON 5.0
event.description: Cyclothon 2026 is a cycling marathon organized by the SDG Campus Club every year as part of INNOVISION Fest. The event aims to promote sustainable transportation, environmental awareness, physical fitness, and active participation in building a healthier and more sustainable future. Participants take 2 rounds of the entire campus starting from Jagda Gate, covering a total of 17 checkpoints, corresponding to the 17 Sustainable Development Goals given by the United Nations.

event.title: Design Dash
event.description: Design Dash is a fast-paced, four-stage design competition that challenges creativity, observation, problem-solving, and teamwork. Participants will race through activities including finding colour matches, navigating a design maze, solving scribble-based challenges, and building paper planes. Each round tests a different design skill, while speed and accuracy add to the excitement. The team with the best overall performance will emerge as the winner.

event.title: Roadies Food Saga
event.description:

 Round-1

event.title: Circuit Heist
event.description: Circuit Heist is a two-day, team-based technical challenge where participants have to recover a sabotaged electronic system. Instead of solving five independent questions, they progress through a connected chain of challenges. They first decode a digital clue, then debug an electronic circuit, solve a logic lock, analyze a timing waveform and finally complete a Verilog RTL challenge. Every successful stage gives them a key to access the next one. Hints and wrong submissions carry time penalties, so both technical ability and strategy matter. The final recovered keys lead to a system-recovery code, and teams are ranked based on their effective completion time.

event.title: VELOCITY VORTEX
event.description: The Velocity Vortex competition challenges teams to race flying vehicles through an obstacle course, with the primary goal of achieving the fastest lap time. Teams get a brief 5-minute preparation period before the race starts, and once that time is up, no physical intervention with the vehicle is allowed. For a chance at extra points, vehicles can optionally pick up a provided ferromagnetic (steel) washer payload before the course and deliver it to the staging area afterward. The final score is calculated from the vehicle's lap ranking combined with any earned payload points. The teams with the highest overall scores will advance to a semi-final round, and the top five of those teams will then compete in the final race.

event.title: REACT
event.description:
REACT: The IIChE Engineering Challenge is an interactive, team-based
 chemical engineering competition that goes beyond the conventional quiz
 format by combining technical knowledge, problem-solving, strategy, and
 resource management. Participants will be provided with a limited set of
 stationery, hint tokens, process cards, and other resources, which they
 must use strategically to solve a series of chemical engineering challenges
 within a fixegived time. From constructing process flows and solving
 engineering problems to making critical decisions about when to use hints
 or conserve resources, every round will test the participants’ ability to think
 eƯiciently under constraints. The event aims to create an engaging and
 competitive environment where participants are rewarded not only for what
 they know, but also for how eƯectively they apply their knowledge, manage
 limited resources, and make decisions under pressure.

event.title: Chem-E-Prix
event.description: Chem-E Prix is a contest where students design, build and operate a vehicle that uses chemical reactions to travel and stop after a specific given distance. The event provides a platform for students to apply the concepts of engineering and innovate a solution in a practical setting.

event.title: The Missing CEO
event.description: The Missing CEO is a business-focused corporate investigation and case-solving challenge where participants act as a review panel to uncover how organizational failures allowed a critical issue to remain hidden. Teams analyse fragmented information, question stakeholders, identify red flags, and connect evidence to diagnose failures in corporate governance, internal controls, reporting, and escalation mechanisms. The event tests strategic thinking, teamwork, analytical reasoning, and business decision-making

event.title: Spancraft
event.description:
SpanCraft is a bridge-building challenge where participants must design and construct a cable-stayed bridge along with its foundation under fixed material and budget constraints.
 
 Each team will receive a fixed initial budget to purchase foundation materials. Sand will be cheaper, while soil will be costlier but provide better foundation performance, forcing teams to make strategic decisions between cost and stability.
 
 For the bridge, teams will be provided with long wooden members and other specified materials. The completed bridge must satisfy the given dimensional requirements and will then be tested for its maximum load-bearing capacity.
 
 The winner will be the team that achieves the best combination of load capacity, dimensional accuracy and cost efficiency.

event.title: Aeroprix
event.description: Aeroprix is the flagship aeromodelling competition of UDAAN, the official Aeromodelling Club of NIT Rourkela. Bringing together aviation enthusiasts, innovators, and aspiring engineers from across the country, Aeroprix challenges participants to design, build, and fly high-performance radio-controlled aircraft.
